import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { Cart } from "../src/cart.js";

describe("Cart", () => {
  let cart;

  beforeEach(() => {
    cart = new Cart({ currency: "EUR" });
  });

  describe("add", () => {
    it("adds a new line item", () => {
      cart.add({ sku: "A1", price: 250, qty: 1 });
      expect(cart.lines).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it("merges quantities for the same sku", () => {
      cart.add({ sku: "A1", price: 250, qty: 1 });
      cart.add({ sku: "A1", price: 250, qty: 2 });
      expect(cart.lines[0].qty).toBe(3);
    });

    describe("validation", () => {
      it("rejects a zero quantity", () => {
        expect(() => cart.add({ sku: "A1", price: 250, qty: 0 })).toThrow(
          "qty must be positive",
        );
      });
    });
  });

  describe("totals", () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      cart.add({ sku: "A1", price: 250, qty: 2 });
      cart.add({ sku: "B7", price: 1000, qty: 1 });
    });

    it("sums line totals", () => {
      expect(cart.subtotal()).toBe(1500);
    });

    it("applies a percentage discount", () => {
      cart.applyDiscount({ percent: 10 });
      expect(cart.total()).toBe(1350);
    });

    describe("rounding", () => {
      it("rounds half cents up", () => {
        cart.applyDiscount({ percent: 33 });
        expect(cart.total()).toBe(1005);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("remove", () => {
    it("drops the line when qty reaches zero", () => {
      cart.add({ sku: "A1", price: 250, qty: 1 });
      cart.remove("A1", 1);
      expect(cart.lines).toEqual([]);
    });

    describe("errors", () => {
      it("throws for an unknown sku", () => {
        expect(() => cart.remove("ZZ", 1)).toThrow("unknown sku ZZ");
      });
    });
  });
});
